item.title: SCOTT STAPP Says CREED Is Rebuilding: 'We're Talking About New Music'
item.description: CREED frontman Scott Stapp says the band is easing back into things after more than a decade apart. In a recent interview, he shared that the group has been spending time together, reflecting on the past, and having early conversations about making new music (via Meltdown) (transcribed by BLABBERMOUTH.
